name: Yuina
source:
The girl who moved in next door. Through that connection, she became close with the protagonist and others.

Despite her appearance, she possesses keen intuition and insight, which often leads her to cause trouble. These incidents seem almost calculated, but the truth remains unclear.

Recently, her chest has finally begun to develop, and she seems very pleased about it. As the story progresses, she freely reveals her immature body.

[From [url=http://www.fiction7.com/erosugi.html]official site[/url]]
